gloss: grand occasion; big stage; moment in the spotlight

definitions.gloss: grand occasion; big stage; moment in the spotlight
definitions.explanation: A formal or public occasion where someone has the opportunity to shine, such as a graduation ceremony, wedding, important competition, or major performance. Conveys a sense of pride and special significance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{晴|は}れ{舞台|ぶたい}だ。
examples.english: The graduation ceremony is a grand occasion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{晴|は}れ{舞台|ぶたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見届|みとど}けたい→見届ける：07170_mitodokeru⟧。
examples.english: I want to witness my daughter's big moment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何年|なんねん}→何年：12737_nannen⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成果|せいか}→成果：06745_seika⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発揮|はっき}する→発揮する：17267_hakkisuru⟧{晴|は}れ{舞台|ぶたい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{堂々|どうどう}→堂々：05895_doudou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{演|えん}じた→演じる：13330_enjiru⟧。
examples.english: On the big stage where he could show the results of years of practice, he performed with confidence.

notes:
USAGE:
{晴|は}れ{舞台|ぶたい} is a compound of ⟦{晴|は}れ→晴れ：02936_hare⟧ (formal, celebratory; as in ⟦{晴|は}れ→晴れ：02936_hare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧) and ⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧ (stage). It does not necessarily refer to an actual stage — it describes any occasion where someone is the center of attention in a proud, positive way. Common for life milestones and competitive events.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {晴|は}れ{舞台|ぶたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (to stand on the big stage)
- {晴|は}れ{舞台|ぶたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧ (to grace the grand occasion)
- {晴|は}れ{舞台|ぶたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見届|みとど}ける→見届ける：07170_mitodokeru⟧ (to witness someone's big moment)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {晴|は}れ{舞台|ぶたい}: grand occasion (milestone, spotlight moment)
- ⟦{晴|は}れ→晴れ：02936_hare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧: special day, auspicious day
- {檜舞台|ひのきぶたい}: the big stage (similar meaning, more literary)
- {大舞台|おおぶたい}: major stage (grand venue or important competition)
